summary: Capital Tankers Corp. operates crude and product tankers. The company owns a fleet of 30 vessels comprising 12 crude carriers, 10 Suezmax tankers, and 8 Aframax/LR2 tankers. It serves customers in the global crude oil transportation sector. Capital Tankers Corp. was incorporated in 2026 and is headquartered in Piraeus, Greece. Capital Tankers Corp. operates as a subsidiary of Capital Maritime & Trading Corp.
